title: Bulgaria – Software package and information systems – „Доставка, инсталация и интеграция на комплексна система за работа с изкуствен интелект“
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка включва доставка, инсталация, интеграция, конфигуриране и въвеждане в експлоатация на комплексна система за работа с изкуствен интелект, както и поддръжка на новата и на съществуващата инфраструктура, предназначена за развитие и повишаване на технологичния и аналитичния капацитет на ДАНС. Системата следва да осигури високопроизводителна, защитена и устойчива среда за обработка и анализ на структурирани и неструктурирани данни, използване и дообучаване на модели с изкуствен интелект (ИИ), включително големи езикови модели (LLM), както и автоматизация на процесите по анализ, оценка на рискове и превенция на заплахи. Доставяните хардуерни и софтуерни компоненти следва да бъдат интегрирани в единно технологично решение, съвместно със съществуващата инфраструктура. За да се осъществи интегриране и функциониране на цялостната система е необходимо да се осигури поддръжка и на съществуващата инфраструктура. Изпълнението на обществената поръчка е структурирано в четири дейности, като видът и количествата им са подробно описани в Техническата спецификация с ниво на класификация „Секретно” на основание т. 14 от раздел II на приложение №1 към чл. 25 във връзка с чл. 28, ал. 2, т. 2 и §1, т. 13, т. 14 и т. 15, буква „б“ от ДР на ЗЗКИ.

title: FMU-167/B Hard Target Void Sensing Fuze (HTVSF) System
description: PURPOSE The U.S. Government (USG) is conducting market research to identify qualified sources for a potential FMU-167/B Fuze System procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 332993 � Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing, which has a corresponding size standard of 1,500 employees. description: 12 August Amendment 02 to revise documents as a result of Q&A. 28 Jul 26 Amendment 01 to revised documents as a result of Q&A. 10 Jul 26 Center Console Refresh addresses critical obsolescence issues within the KC-135 Refueling Tanker aircraft. description: NASA/Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center (JSC) has a requirement for simulation and software technology support primarily for the JSC Engineering Directorate Software, Robotics, and Simulation Division (SRSD) in support of human exploration systems and programs, including the International Space Station (ISS), Artemis Program, Orion Multi-Purpose Crew Vehicle (MPCV), and advanced programs for exploration and research. The contractor is responsible for developing and supporting simulation and Virtual Reality (VR) applications for Extravehicular Activity (EVA) training systems, robotics training systems, and engineering analysis, as well as developing situational awareness and planning software. The SRSD is also responsible for providing engineering products and analysis in the areas of Orion flight software management, Vehicle System Management (VSM), automation and intelligent systems, and telerobotics and autonomous robotic systems for ground and space flight applications services. title: Delivery and installation of a High ion density etcher for lithium niobate on insulator - LiNb03 (LN)
description: DTU Nanolab wishes to acquire a high ion density source reactive ion etcher for etching lithium niobate on insulator 150 mm wafer processing. Delivery is expected no later than Q4 2027. We are looking for a highly versatile instrument providing stable etch recipes, capable of etching at both nanometer scale and micrometer scale with precise control of etching depth, typically a few hundreds of nm. The instrument must have state-of-the-art performance in terms of profile control, uniformity, selectivity, and in particu-lar etching sidewall smoothness to achieve low waveguide loss. The Instrument will be installed in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom - a university facility providing a comprehensive suite of micro- and nanofabrication tools. It serves a diverse community of over 200 active users, ranging from novice students to experienced researchers, as well a high percentage of commercial clients. At DTU Nanolab there are several research groups and companies working on developing and running small scale production of optical devises on the tools. Therefor the capability of etching smooth optical waveguide, gratings and other low-roughness optical devises are of high importance to us.

title: 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day
description: ? Celebrating Our 6th Annual Industry Day � Connecting Native-Owned Businesses with Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS) ? Monday, September 28 & Tuesday, September 29, 2026 ? 9:00 a.m. � 3:00 p.m. Mountain Daylight Time (MDT) ? Virtual Event | Microsoft Teams ?? FREE to Participate ? Space is limited. Registration will close once all vendor presentation slots have been filled. The Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS), Division of Contracts and Grants Management (DCGM), invites Native American-owned small businesses to participate in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, a two-day virtual event dedicated to strengthening partnerships, expanding the Albuquerque Area IHS supplier base, and increasing awareness of the capabilities of Native American-owned businesses. Held shortly before Indigenous Peoples� Day, this event provides Native American-owned small businesses, including eligible Small Business Indian Firms (SBIFs) and Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs), an opportunity to introduce their organizations and showcase their capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals, program stakeholders, and organizational leadership. ?? Event Overview Day One will begin with introductions from Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals and a brief overview of the Buy Indian Act and its role in supporting Indian economic enterprises through federal procurement. Following the opening session, participating vendors will receive an individually scheduled 10-minute presentation slot to introduce their businesses and highlight their capabilities, qualifications, products, services, past performance, and other information relevant to potential Albuquerque Area IHS requirements. Vendor capability presentations will continue throughout both days. ? Vendor Capability Presentations This is your opportunity to show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals. Vendors are encouraged to use their presentation time to highlight information such as: Core capabilities and areas of expertise Products and/or services offered Relevant experience and past performance Geographic areas served Unique capabilities or solutions How your business can support IHS healthcare operations and mission requirements ? Who Will Be in the Audience? The Industry Day is designed to connect Native American-owned businesses with Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals involved in identifying requirements, conducting market research, planning acquisitions, making purchases, and administering contracts. The audience may include: Buyers Contract Specialists Contracting Officers Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs) Government Purchase Cardholders and Approving Officials Service Unit Chief Executive Officers Program and technical personnel Albuquerque Area leadership This broad audience provides participating businesses an opportunity to increase awareness of their capabilities across IHS while helping acquisition and program personnel identify potential sources for future requirements. ? Why Participate? The Albuquerque Area IHS is committed to meaningful industry engagement and expanding opportunities for Native American-owned small businesses. Participation in Industry Day provides businesses an opportunity to: Introduce their company directly to IHS acquisition, program, and organizational personnel Increase awareness of their products, services, and capabilities Help IHS identify new and emerging industry capabilities Support IHS market research and acquisition planning Develop relationships with acquisition and program personnel Increase awareness of potential opportunities to do business with IHS At the same time, these interactions help Albuquerque Area IHS broaden its procurement base, identify qualified sources, increase competition, and strengthen relationships with the Native American-owned business community. We want to learn what your business can do for IHS. ? How to Participate Native American-owned small businesses interested in participating should email: ALBAreaSmallBusiness@ihs.gov Please indicate your interest in participating in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day and include your business name and primary point of contact. Upon receipt of your email, the Albuquerque Area IHS will provide a registration form to collect additional business information and assist with scheduling. Presentation times will be scheduled in advance. Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities, qualifications, products, and/or services. Space is limited, and registration will close once all available vendor presentation slots have been filled. Vendors are encouraged to register early. Additional event and Microsoft Teams information will be provided to registered participants prior to the event. ? Building Partnerships in Support of the IHS Mission Through the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, DCGM seeks to strengthen relationships with Native American-owned businesses, expand awareness of industry capabilities, broaden the Albuquerque Area procurement base, and identify qualified sources capable of supporting healthcare delivery. These partnerships help ensure that Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals have access to capable and innovative businesses that can provide the supplies, services, equipment, and solutions necessary to support direct patient care and advance the IHS mission: �To raise the physical, mental, social and spiritual health of American Indians and Alaska Natives to the highest level.� ? Join us September 28-29, 2026, and show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! ?? Important Notice This Industry Day is being conducted for informational, outreach, and market research purposes. This event is not a bidder�s conference, solicitation, Request for Proposal, Request for Quote, promise to contract, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. Participation in this event does not guarantee consideration for or award of any future procurement. The Government will not assume liability for costs incurred by any participant associated with attending the event or preparing, submitting, or presenting information, capability statements, presentations, or other materials. title: Netherlands – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Supply and Analysis of NH₃ Passive Samplers (Diffusion Tubes) for the MAN Network and additional projects
description: This European tender concerns a contract for the supply and laboratory analysis of ammonia (NH₃) passive samplers (diffusion tubes) for the Dutch ammonia monitoring network “Meetnet Ammoniak Nederland” (MAN) and various additional projects. The contractor will be responsible for the monthly supply of unexposed diffusion tubes to RIVM, the analysis of exposed tubes supplied by RIVM, and the digital reporting of validated results. Field deployment, return logistics of exposed tubes and internal data processing by RIVM fall outside the scope. The expected annual volume ranges from approximately 6,600 tubes in the baseline MAN scenario up to around 9,900 tubes including additional projects, with a maximum bandwidth of up to 30,000 tubes per year to accommodate future growth. If the contract is awarded to a new supplier, the first contract year will include a structured Double Measurement Programme, in which the new laboratory’s performance is systematically compared with the current trend laboratory to ensure continuity and trend stability in the MAN data series. The contract is tendered as one single, integrated lot combining tube supply, analysis and reporting with one contractor, using a best price‑quality ratio award criterion. The agreement has a fixed initial duration of six (6) years starting 1 January 2027, with five (5) optional one‑year extensions, for a maximum total duration of eleven (11) years.

Die zu reinigenden Gesamtflächen betragen im Jahr 946.696,08m² (Oberschule an der Helgolander Straße), 901.086,96m² (Marie-Curie-Schule), 769.884,60m² (Schule Oberneuland) und 600.528,43m² (Kippenberg-Gymnasium). Objektbegehungen finden am 12.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Oberschule an der Helgolander Straße), am 13.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Schule Oberneuland), am 13.10.2026 um 11:30 Uhr (Marie-Curie-Schule) und am 14.10.2026 um 10:00 Uhr (Kippenberg-Gymnasium) statt. Die Begehung der Gebäude ist verpflichtend; eine Nichtteilnahme führt zum Ausschluss vom Vergabeverfahren bezogen auf das jeweilige Los. Sollten Sie also bspw. ausschließlich bei der Begehung am 12.10.2026 teilnehmen, werden Angebote für die Lose 2, 3 und 4 von der Wertung ausgeschlossen und nur das Angebot für Los 1 gewertet. Eine Anmeldung ist nur bis zum 09.10.2026 um 12:00 Uhr möglich. Bitte melden Sie sich per E-Mail an: gebaeudeservice@immobilien.bremen.de Nach der Anmeldung erhalten Sie eine Bestätigung mit weiteren Details (u.a. zum Treffpunkt). Bitte teilen Sie uns auch mit, an welchen der vier Begehungen Sie teilnehmen möchten (alle oder nur einzelne). Waschmaschinenanschlüsse sind in der Marie-Curie-Schule, der Schule Oberneuland und im Kippenberg-Gymnasium vorhanden. Die Vergabestelle behält sich vor, Angebote, deren effektiver Stundenverrechnungssatz (einschließlich aller gewährten Nachlässe) unter 180% des derzeit gültigen Tariflohnes liegt und damit unauskömmlich erscheint, vertieft zu prüfen. Angebote, deren effektiver Stundenverrechnungssatz unter 170% des derzeit gültigen Tariflohnes liegt, erscheinen automatisch unauskömmlich und werden direkt ohne weitere Prüfung ausgeschlossen. Die Vergabestelle fordert daher alle Bieter auf, den dem Angebot zugrunde liegenden Stundenverrechnungssatz gemäß dem Schema des Bundesinnungsverbandes Gebäudereinigung darzustellen und die Auskömmlichkeit des Angebots in den Einzelbestandteilen nachzuweisen. Soweit die Zweifel an der Auskömmlichkeit im Rahmen der vertieften Prüfung nicht vollständig ausgeräumt werden können, wird das Angebot von der weiteren Wertung ausgeschlossen. Dies gilt auch dann, wenn der Bieter seiner Aufklärungspflicht nicht oder nicht in der Form nachkommt, dass rückfragefrei erkennbar und mit Nachweisen belegt wird, dass alle Kostenpositionen analog branchenüblicher Standards transparent hergeleitet wurden. title: Switzerland – Road bridge construction work – Ersatzbau Brücke über den Giessen, Grünaustrasse (GI 8)
description: Die Giessenbrücke Grünaustrasse (GI 8) ist in einem schadhaften Zustand und wurde auf eine maximale Fahrzeuggesamtlast von 30 to beschränkt. Für die Erstellung des Untergeschosses der Überbauung Chez Fritz muss ein Teil der nördlichen Brückenkonsole abgebrochen und aufgrund der Parzellenausfahrt (Anlieferung) umgebaut und verstärkt werden. Die bestehenden Gehwegbereiche dürfen nicht befahren werden und das Durchflussprofil entspricht nicht den aktuell zur Dimensionierung massgebenden Wassermengen. Die Brücke soll auf Beschluss des Stadtrats durch einen Neubau ersetzt werden, wobei einerseits die Stützweite aus hydraulischen Gründen massiv vergrössert werden muss, andererseits die Unterkante der Brückenplatte im Vergleich zum Bestand nicht weiter abgesenkt werden darf. Die neue Brücke wird als schiefwinklige, einfeldrige Stahlbetonplatte mit einer lichten Weite von 14.49 m (in Strassenachse) bzw. 12.60 m (rechtwinklig zur Bachachse), einer Gesamtbreite von 13.80 m und einer Stärke von 60.5 cm bis 0.81 cm konzipiert. Die Brückenplatte wird mit den Widerlagern monolithisch verbunden (integrale Bauweise). Die Widerlager werden parallel zum Giessen ausgerichtet, wobei das westseitige Widerlager der Flucht der UG-Aussenwand Chez Fritz angepasst wird und damit im Vergleich zur heutigen Lage leicht nach Osten verschoben wird. Das Bauwerk wird flach im Rheinschotter fundiert. Während dem Neubau der Brücke wird der Verkehr inkl. Busverkehr jedoch ohne Schwerverkehr (max. 30 to) infolge des derzeit im Bau befindlichen Objekts „Chez Fritz“ temporär über die oberwasserseitige Zufahrtsbrücke (GI 7) und den nördlichen Teil des Parkplatzes zur Heldaustrasse geleitet. Für die Ausführung wird mit einer Gesamtbauzeit von 8 Monaten gerechnet.

Udział pojazdów kategorii N2 i N3 w całkowitej liczbie pojazdów tych kategorii objętych zamówieniem musi być nie mniejszy niż 9%. Wykonawca zobowiązany jest do uwzględniania ewentualnych zmian przepisów u.e.p.a., polegających w szczególności na zmianie wielkości udziału pojazdów napędzanych paliwami alternatywnymi lub przesunięciu wskazanych w niej dat. 4.1.3 Na wezwanie Zamawiającego, Wykonawca zobowiązany jest przedłożyć Zamawiającemu w terminie wskazanym w tym wezwaniu, nie dłuższym jednak niż 10 dni licząc od dnia otrzymania wezwania, pisemne oświadczenie wskazujące jaki jest łączny udział pojazdów napędzanych paliwami alternatywnymi we flocie pojazdów samochodowych w rozumieniu art. 2 pkt 33 ustawy z 20.06.1997 r. Prawo o ruchu drogowym – dalej p.r.d., używanych przy wykonywania przedmiotu umowy – mając na względzie postanowienie ust. 4.1.2. 4.1.4. Tym samym Zamawiający nie dopuszcza składania ofert częściowych. Powody niedokonania podziału: Zamawiający nie przewiduje podziału zamówienia na części w związku z wykonywaniem usług ściśle ze sobą powiązanych pod względem technicznym. Podział zamówienia na części mógłby utrudnić realizację zamówienia, wpływać na jej terminowość prawidłowość wykonania, powodować nadmierne trudności techniczne i niepożądany wzrost kosztów. Ponadto brak podziału zamówienia na części nie wpływa na ograniczenie konkurencyjności. 4.3 Oznaczenie wg Wspólnego Słownika Zamówień CPV. Główny przedmiot: 90500000-2 - usługi związane z odpadami. title: France – Disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables – Fourniture de dispositifs médicaux de neuroradiologie interventionnelle
description: Il s’agit d’un appel d’offres ouvert en application des articles L2124-2, R2124-2, 1° et R2161-2 à R2161-5 du Code de la Commande Publique.Le marché public est un accord-cadre qui fixe toutes les stipulations contractuelles. Il est exécuté au fur et à mesure de l'émission de bons de commande dans les conditions fixées aux articles R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du Code de la commande publique. L’accord-cadre est conclu sans minimum et avec un maximum exprimé en quantité au sens de l’article R2162-4, 2° du code de la commande publique. Les quantités maximums contractuelles pour toute la durée du marché sont définies à l’annexe 1 du CCTP « Catalogue des besoins ». Le marché public est mono-attributaire à l’exception des lots 10/25/26/28/33/35/36/42 et 45. Pour ces derniers, le marché public est multi-attributaire afin que le établissements membres puissent disposer d’un panel de dispositifs médicaux et d’implants susceptibles de répondre aux différents patients à prendre en charge. Les modalités d’attribution des bons de commande entre les différents titulaires sont les suivantes : Pour les lots 10/25/26/28/33/35/36/42, le marché public est attribué à 2 titulaires distincts maximum sous réserve d'un nombre suffisant de candidats et d'offres. Le pourcentage d’unités commandées sous douze mois sera relatif au classement des soumissionnaires retenus. Le pourcentage d’unités commandées est réparti entre les titulaires de la manière suivante : ­ Lot 10 1er 80% - 2ième 20% ­ Lot 25 1er 90% - 2ième 10% ­ Lot 26 1er 80% - 2ième 20% ­ Lot 28 1er 90% - 2ième 10% ­ Lot 33 1er 60% - 2ième 40% ­ Lot 35 1er 70% - 2ième 30% ­ Lot 36 1er 70% - 2ième 30% ­ Lot 42 1er 80% - 2ième 20% Pour le lot 45, le marché public est attribué à 2 titulaires distincts maximum sous réserve d'un nombre suffisant de candidats et d'offres. Le pourcentage d’unités commandées sous douze mois est relatif au classement des soumissionnaires retenus. Le pourcentage d’unités commandées est réparti entre les titulaires de la manière suivante : - Lot 45 1er 70% - 2ième 30%. Si une seule offre est reçue, le CHU de Rennes pourra attribuer le marché à un seul soumissionnaire. L’ensemble des fournitures pouvant être commandées est décrit au cahier des clauses techniques particulières (CCTP) et à l’annexe n°01 du CCTP : catalogue des besoins. Par ailleurs, pour les lots concernés dans le catalogue des besoins, les établissements parties peuvent commander, au fur et à mesure de leurs besoins, dans la limite de 10% des quantités minimum du marché public, dans le catalogue du titulaire, des produits complémentaires, non listés au BPU du lot concerné, portant sur l’objet dudit lot (même gamme). Les quantités estimatives du marché public sont indiquées à l’annexe n°04 du RC : Tableau des quantités estimatives par établissement. Ces quantités n’ont pas valeur contractuelle. Elles ne servent qu’à l’analyse des offres. Le marché public est conclu pour une période initiale allant du 01/04/2027 ou à compter sa date de notification si celle-ci est postérieure à la date initialement prévue au 01/04/2027, au 31/03/2028. Le marché public peut ensuite être reconduit deux (2) fois par période successive d’un (1) an, soit jusqu’au 31 mars 2030. Cette reconduction est tacite (ceci signifie que le silence gardé par le CHU de Rennes reconduit automatiquement le marché public). Le délai de validité des offres est fixé à huit (8) mois à compter de la date limite de réception des offres.

description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest realizacja badań pilotażowych i normalizacyjnych służących ocenie baterii testów przeznaczonych do pomiaru uzdolnień matematycznych, językowych i naukowo-badawczych w ramach projektu “Wspieranie dostępności edukacji dla dzieci i młodzieży” (numer projektu: FERS.01.06-IP.05-0002/23). Realizacja badania przez Wykonawcę oznacza przeprowadzenie badań z wykorzystaniem nowatorskich narzędzi diagnostycznych do pomiaru uzdolnień matematycznych, naukowo-badawczych i językowych dla dzieci w wieku 7-17 lat. Celem przedmiotu zamówienia jest pilotaż (weryfikacja poprawności stworzonych narzędzi) oraz badanie normalizacyjne (opracowanie norm). Badanie zostanie przeprowadzone w formie mieszanej: elektronicznej oraz tradycyjnej (papier-ołówek). Uczestnikami badania będą uczniowie w wieku 7 - 17 lat. Planuje się, że w obu etapach (pilotaż i normalizacja) przebadanych zostanie łącznie 5 650 uczniów. Badanie zostanie przeprowadzone w szkołach - na etapie pilotażu dobór próby (zgodny z wytycznymi Zamawiającego) pozostaje po stronie Wykonawcy, na etapie badania normalizacyjnego wylosowaną próbę (główną i rezerwową) dostarczy Zamawiający. Kwestionariusze zostaną także wypełnione przez rodziców i nauczycieli. Opis przedmiotu zamówienia oraz opis sposobu wykonania zamówienia zawarty jest Specyfikacji Warunków Zamówienia i załącznikach.

title: Norway – Vehicle-fleet management services – Contract for the purchase, leasing and operation of vehicles.
description: 1 General Description 1.1 About the Contracting Authority The contracting authority for this competition is Møre og Romsdal county, c/o the County Road Department. See the website www.mrfylke.no for information on the Contracting Authority. 1.2 About the Assignment - the objective of the procurement 1.2.1 Purpose The contracting authority needs to enter into a contract with a supplier of vehicle administration. The procurement/agreement shall include both the purchase (new vehicle) and leasing (operational) of official vehicles as well as vehicle administration of official cars. The contracting authority needs a system that ensures a modern, economic, safe and environmentally friendly vehicle fleet as well as an intuitive administration of the fleet of vehicles. The chosen tenderer must also be an advisory and solution orientated cooperation partner. 1.2.2 Extent As stated in point 1.2.1, the contract shall include: 1. Purchase and leasing (operational) of official vehicles 2. Vehicle administration with travel log and fleet management (option). Delivery under point 1: As regards the procurement of a new vehicle under point 1, the competition concludes that tenders will not be submitted for concrete vehicle models, but on vehicle groups. The choice of a specific type of vehicle within the defined vehicle groups will be made when ordered during the contract period. Examples of vehicle types that will be ordered are in the price form, annex 4, tab 4. If the vehicle is procured, the tenderer shall act as a "communicator" where he collects tender offers based on predetermined procedures, cf. The assignment description annex point 1.1.2 Selection of vehicles/tenders is to be made by the contracting authority. The price of this service (facilitation) is an award per vehicle. There is a price for this communication fee that is being competed on. When leasing, suppliers offer vehicles within defined vehicle groups, where prices for leasing are calculated according to cost price, i.e. purchase price with deduction for discounts + specified equipment and possibly fittings. The price of the leasing is limited based on cost price, hire period, NIBOR interest + fixed mark-up percentage and calculated remaining value. After the expired hire period, the Contracting Authority can choose to procure the vehicle. The competition has a fixed mark-up percentage per vehicle group that is being competed on. Delivery under point 2: The delivery vehicle administration includes the following: Vehicle administration: General management of the fleet, including: Electronic logbook: Automatic documentation of driving for tax purposes Fleet management: Real time tracing, driver follow-up, overview of service intervals, cf. The assignment description, annex 2 point 3. See the assignment's further information in the Assignment Description (Annex 2) and the Requirement Specifications (Annex 3).
